data.name: Rhetorical Flourish (Mythic)
data.description: You're supremely skilled at using verbal misdirection and finesse to influence others.

raw_tokens.value: You're supremely skilled at using verbal misdirection and finesse to influence others.

When you successfully use Rhetorical Flourish against a non-mythic creature, the bonus on your Diplomacy check increases by +%1. If the target is a mythic creature, you instead increase the bonus by +%2. You can expend one use of mythic power to reroll a single failed Bluff check. You must take the new result even if it is lower.|MythicLevel|HalfMythicLevel
